title: TabFORGE: A Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling
abstract: arXiv:2605.09424v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative modelling is a demanding test of foundation models, because it requires robust, holistic representation learning for a given data modality, rather than optimisation for a supervised prediction target alone. While recent work on tabular foundation models has achieved remarkable progress in predictive modelling, generative tabular foundation models remain underexplored. Existing tabular foundation generators, in particular, have not yet consistently matched strong dataset-specific generators in synthetic data quality. A key reason is their insufficient alignment with the inter-feature dependency structure of tabular data, which can reflect underlying causal relationships. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a novel tabular foundation model, \textbf{TabFORGE}, built on pretrained \textbf{Tab}ular \textbf{FO}undational \textbf{R}epresentations for \textbf{GE}neration. translated_title: TabFORGE：一个用于生成建模的表格基础模型
translated_abstract: 生成建模是对基础模型的一项高要求测试，因为它需要针对给定数据模态进行稳健、全面的表示学习，而不仅仅是针对监督预测目标进行优化。尽管近期关于表格基础模型的研究在预测建模方面取得了显著进展，但生成式表格基础模型仍未得到充分探索。尤其是，现有的表格基础生成器在合成数据质量方面尚未能持续匹敌强大的针对特定数据集的生成器。一个关键原因在于它们与表格数据的特征间依赖结构（可能反映潜在因果关系）的对齐不足。在本文中，我们通过引入一种新颖的表格基础模型 TabFORGE 来填补这一空白，该模型建立在预训练的表格基础生成表示（Tabular FOundational Representations for GEneration）之上。TabFORGE 旨在利用可迁移的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了TabFORGE——一个基于预训练表格基础生成表示的新型表格基础模型，通过更好地对齐表格数据的特征间依赖结构，显著提升生成式表格建模的合成数据质量。
en_tdlr: TabFORGE is a novel tabular foundation model for generative modelling, built on pretrained Tabular Foundational Representations for Generation, which improves synthetic data quality by better aligning with the inter-feature dependency structure of tabular data.
